top_verse_en: "Come and see," He replied. So they went and saw where He was staying, and spent that day with Him. It was about the tenth hour.

refs.t_en: "Can anything good come from Nazareth?" Nathanael asked. "Come and see, " said Philip.
Everyone the Father gives Me will come to Me, and the one who comes to Me I will never drive away.
Judas (not Iscariot) asked Him, "Lord, why are You going to reveal Yourself to us and not to the world?" . . .
I love those who love me, and those who seek me early shall find me.
Come to Me, all you who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest. . . .
So when the Samaritans came to Him, they asked Him to stay with them, and He stayed two days.
Paul stayed there two full years in his own rented house, welcoming all who came to visit him. . . .
Behold, I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears My voice and opens the door, I will come in and dine with him, and he with Me.
But they pleaded with Him, "Stay with us, for it is nearly evening and the day is almost over." So He went in to stay with them.

outline.text_en: The divinity, humanity, office, and incarnation of Jesus Christ.
The calling of Simon and Andrew, Philip and Nathanael

parallel_en.text: He said to them, "Come, and you will see." So they came and saw where He was staying; and they stayed with Him that day, for it was about the tenth hour.
